title: Bengaluru: ASHA workers' indefinite strike enters sixth day demanding Rs 15k honorarium

ai.summary: ASHA workers in Bengaluru have been striking for six days demanding a 15,000 rupee honorarium, after waiting over 18 months for government discussion.

facts.claim: ASHA workers' indefinite strike enters sixth day
facts.quote: ASHA workers' indefinite strike enters sixth day demanding Rs 15k honorarium
Reacting to CM's remarks seeking more time to consider the demand, the ASHA workers said they had waited for one-and-a-half years and exhausted all avenues of discussion with the govt.
